subject: Re: Quick product walk-through for Novatech
messages:
From: Alex Chu <alex.chu@novatech.com>
To: soojin_lee@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 6 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Quick product walk-through for Novatech

Hi Soojin,

Thanks again for the intro earlier this week. Our team is excited to see Redwood in action — mainly the routing/fallback behavior and latency numbers across small bursts. Would you / your team be able to run a 45-minute walkthrough this Friday, Aug 8, around 10:00 AM PT? That time works best for Alex (me) and our product lead, Priya.

High-level agenda request: 10m intros, 25m demo (routing + cost controls + console), 10m Q&A.

Attached: Novatech_RFI.docx (short answers to a few security/retention questions our compliance asked for)

Appreciate the quick turnaround — we can be flexible if that slot doesn't work.

Best,
Alex Chu
Sr. Product Manager, Novatech
alex.chu@novatech.com
+1 (415) 555-0134

From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>

Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>

Alex — thanks, Friday 10:00 PT works on our side. I can host the invite. Karthik will lead the demo (routing + Optimize recommendations) and Connor will handle the console/observability section.

Attaching a short agenda and a 45-minute invite we can send. If you want to add any specific test cases (e.g., throughput targets or region constraints), drop them here and we'll prep.

Attachments: demo-agenda.pdf

See you Friday — Soojin

Soojin — sorry to jump in with bad timing. I just noticed an itinerary conflict: I'm booked onsite with a priority exec customer for all of Friday due to a last-minute travel reschedule. That booking was added to my calendar overnight (no heads-up earlier).

I can do a compressed 30-minute focused demo remotely at 10:00 (cut the deep dive on kernel selection), but I won't be able to run the full 45 with the planned live routing tests. If we want the full coverage (routing + console + Optimize), I recommend handing off to Marissa — she ran the FinOptics proof-of-concept and knows the routing/fallback playbook.

Apologies for the scramble — I can join asynchronously and provide notes, or hop on the last 10 minutes for Q&A if timing allows.

— Karthik
Principal Solutions Engineer, Redwood
From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
To: Alex Chu <alex.chu@novatech.com>, Priya Singh <priya.singh@novatech.com>

Subject: Re: Quick product walk-through for Novatech

Alex / Priya — thanks for flagging; this is short notice on our side as well. Two options to keep Friday's slot:

Option A (recommended): Marissa will run the 45-minute walkthrough at 10:00 PT with the original agenda. Karthik will send a short technical brief and the routing test plan ahead of the call and will join the final 10 minutes for Q&A. This preserves the live demo and test coverage.

Option B (fallback): Keep Karthik as the presenter but compress to 30 minutes and record the session; follow up with an async lab run for the full routing tests.

If you confirm Option A, I'll update the invite and include a short handoff brief (what to run, expected metrics). Marissa — are you good to take this if we switch presenters?

Attachments: handoff-brief.txt; novatech-demo-link.ics

Soojin Lee
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference

See you Friday at 10:00 PT.

Best,
Alex
